description: Check whether an uploaded app has been processed and is ready for features like image injection, network logs, and screenshot unblock on real devices. The TestMu AI API has no read-only status call: this one starts or refreshes the processing for the requested features, so the app's last-updated time changes. An app id that is not among your uploaded apps returns an error.
name: checkAppProcessingStatus
title: Check App Processing Status (Real Device)
